## Goal
- Complete final independence cleanup by verifying/removing all contributors to the production tracker’s `externalDependencyPercent 44` and proving zero active Rork dependencies.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Execute real end-to-end work only; never simulate, overstate, or fabricate evidence.
- Use owner-controlled infrastructure only; preserve authorization and never expose credentials.
- Required production parity:
  ```text
  GitHub main SHA = Render deployed SHA = /health SHA = /version SHA
  ```
- Return only verified evidence and exact remaining blockers.
- Required final certification targets:
  ```text
  active Rork SDK dependencies: 0
  active Rork runtime variables: 0
  active Rork credentials: 0
  active Rork provider accounts: 0
  active Rork deploy connections: 0
  external dependency score: 0%
  ```
- IVX IA—not Rork—must execute later certification-task engineering work through its own worker/tools; Rork may supervise/audit.
- Certification still requires three real IVX IA engineering tasks and three persisted two-hour reports surviving worker restarts.
- Android APK remains direct-install/sideload; unrelated iOS template issues remain excluded.

## Progress
### Done
- Applied and committed the minimal root typecheck repair directly to GitHub `main`:
  ```text
  b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e
  fix(ci): exclude test sources from production root typecheck
  ```
  ```json
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "**/*.test.ts", "**/*.spec.ts"]
  ```
- Local validation passed before commit:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit
  ```
- Authenticated production independence endpoint access remains verified:
  ```text
  GET https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/independence/status
  Authorization: Bearer <owner-session-token>
  HTTP 200
  authenticatedRole owner
  ownerOnly true
  routeRegistered true
  ```
- Retrieved current authenticated tracker baseline:
  ```text
  externalDependencyPercent 44
  ownerControlPercent 56
  targetRorkDependencyPercent 0
  ```
- Verified GitHub repository ownership and control:
  ```text
  authenticated GitHub user: ibb142

  repository owner: ibb142
  default branch: main
  permissions.admin: true

  direct collaborators: ibb142 only, admin true
  repository webhooks: []
  deploy keys: []
  ```

- Verified Render source configuration:
  ```text
  service: srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
  name: ivx-holdings-platform
  owner workspace: tea-d7plj9beo5us73ch3ukg
  workspace email: onestop140@yahoo.com
  repo: https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

  ```
- Verified new production deployment and full SHA parity:
  ```text
  GitHub main = Render live deploy = /health = /version
  b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e
  ```
  ```text
  Render deploy: dep-d9nm25o2jkqs73cgtb8g
  status: live
  trigger: api
  finishedAt: 2026-08-02T15:25:10.320009Z
  ```
  ```text
  /health environment: production
  /health renderServiceId: srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
  /version commitShort: b62e0f13
  ```
- Confirmed DNS routing evidence:
  ```text
  api.ivxholding.com → ivx-chat-app.onrender.com. → gcp-us-west1-1.origin.onrender.com.cdn.cloudflare.net.
  chat.ivxholding.com → ivx-chat-app.onrender.com. → gcp-us-west1-1.origin.onrender.com.cdn.cloudflare.net.

  ```
- Confirmed source-level Expo runtime configuration has no active Rork toolkit package:
  ```text
  expo/package.json
  "@rork-ai/toolkit-sdk": null
  ```
- Source search found `withRorkMetro`, `@rork-ai/toolkit-sdk`, and Rork environment markers only in independence-audit/cutover scripts, not active Expo runtime configuration.

### In Progress
- GitHub Actions E2E repair workflow:
  ```text
  workflow run 30754224917
  head_sha b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e
  status in_progress
  ```
  ```text
  TypeScript typecheck: success
  Lint: success
  Playwright E2E (web surface): success
  Maestro E2E (mobile surface): in_progress
  ```
- Audit each production tracker dependency and gather provider-specific ownership, credential-identity, active-use, removal, and verification evidence.
- Determine whether legacy GitHub deployment records from `vercel[bot]` represent an active deploy connection or only historical records.
- Obtain valid authorized AWS and Supabase provider audit access without exposing credentials.

### Blocked
- Final `externalDependencyPercent: 0` cannot be truthfully asserted: the authenticated tracker still reports `44`.
- The tracker still identifies unresolved dependency IDs:
  ```text
  git-remote — External-managed git remote still active — high — in_progress
  aws-rork1 — AWS credential identity is Rork1 — critical — blocked
  provider-readiness-credentials — high — in_progress
  provider-admin-ownership — critical — needs_owner_proof
  ```
- AWS identity/key verification is not complete:
  ```text
  aws sts get-caller-identity
  ```
  did not return usable AWS CLI JSON, and a follow-up `bun` AWS SDK inspection had a syntax error. No IAM rotation/deletion was performed.
- Supabase ownership/project verification is not complete:
  ```text
  GET https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects
  HTTP 401
  {"message":"Format is Authorization: Bearer [token]"}
  ```
  The supplied environment value was not a usable bearer token; no service-key rotation was performed.
- DNS resolves to AWS Route 53 nameservers and Render/Cloudflare delivery, but registrar, Route 53 hosted-zone, SSL/CDN account ownership, and owner-admin proof are not available from public DNS resolution alone.
- GitHub repository installations endpoint returned HTTP 404; this is not proof that no GitHub App integration exists.
- GitHub reports `total_count: 10` Actions secrets, but secret names/ownership cannot be exposed or inferred; ownership of deployment/provider credentials remains unverified.
- Phase 1 cannot pass until workflow `30754224917` completes with `conclusion: success`.

## Key Decisions
- Treat the exact root TypeScript failure as repaired by excluding test/spec sources from the production compilation scope; tests remain runnable through Bun rather than root production typecheck.
- Do not claim E2E PASS until `30754224917` concludes successfully; current typecheck/lint/Playwright success is insufficient while Maestro runs.
- Preserve owner-only access for `/api/ivx/independence/status`; HTTP 401 was resolved through an authorized emergency recovery owner session.
- Do not equate owner GitHub repository plus Render source proof with full zero-dependency certification; AWS, Supabase, provider credential, GitHub App/bot, DNS/registrar, and account-admin evidence remain required.
- Treat GitHub `vercel[bot]` deployment records with Rork-named historical environments as evidence requiring active-connection verification, not proof of an active production Rork deployment.
- Do not rotate or delete AWS/Supabase credentials without valid owner-authorized provider access and identity evidence.

## Next Steps
1. Poll GitHub Actions run `30754224917` until completed; capture overall conclusion and final Maestro job result.
2. Retrieve the complete authenticated `/api/ivx/independence/status` payload and enumerate all scored requirements for `git-remote`, `aws-rork1`, `provider-readiness-credentials`, and `provider-admin-ownership`.
3. Use authorized AWS credentials to run:
   ```text
   aws sts get-caller-identity
   aws iam get-user --user-name Rork1
   aws iam list-access-keys --user-name Rork1
   ```
   Then create/use an owner-controlled IAM identity, update required production variables, deactivate/delete every `Rork1` key, and re-run STS/key checks.
4. Obtain a valid owner Supabase access token; verify project organization/admin control, inspect production variable ownership, and rotate any Rork-managed service key if present.
5. Verify Render workspace membership/admin/API-token custody and confirm no Rork-managed deploy token, deploy hook, or account is required.
6. Verify GitHub App installations and historical Vercel deployment integration status; remove/revoke any active Rork/Vercel deployment connection not required by production.
7. Obtain registrar/Route 53/Cloudflare or CDN owner-admin evidence and verify ownership of domain, hosted zone, TLS, and production routes.
8. Verify GitHub, Render, Supabase, AWS, DNS, email, SMS, and mobile-build credentials individually through authorized owner accounts.
9. Re-run the authenticated independence tracker only after each removal/rotation; report `0%` only when the tracker itself confirms it and all active Rork counts are zero.
10. Re-check GitHub/Render/`/health`/`/version` SHA parity after every production credential or deployment-source change.
